note: Latest-news panel that floats in the bottom-right corner of the page, built by js/newsOverlayFilling.js. Newest item first. Each item: 'id' (required and unique; when the first item's id changes, the panel opens again for visitors who had closed it), 'date' (optional), 'icon' (Font Awesome classes, optional), 'text' (required, HTML allowed), 'link' and 'linkText' (optional). Set 'show' to false to remove the panel and its button.
title: Latest news

items.text: Our paper “Engineering Requirements for Generative AI Agents: The BARD Process Theory” has been accepted at the ICSE 2027 Research Track.

Best Technical Paper Award at ESEM 2026, category “Timely and Significant Contribution”, for “Out of Place in My Own Work: How Generative AI Displaces Software Engineers”, with Theocharis Tavantzis and Daniel Russo.
